name: Ōmiwa Shrine
heritage: Important Cultural Property of Japan; Historic Site of Japan
type: Shinto shrine; Miwa shrines; moto-Ise; Shrines receiving Tsukinami-sai and Niiname-sai offerings; Shrines receiving Tsukinami-sai and Niiname-sai and Ainame-sai offerings; Shikinai Ronsha; Shiki
text: Ōmiwa Shrine (大神神社, Ōmiwa-jinja), also known as Miwa Shrine (三輪神社, Miwa-jinja; alternately written as Miwa-myōjin (三輪明神)), is a Shinto shrine located in Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. The shrine is notable because it contains no sacred images or objects, since it is believed to serve Mount Miwa, the mountain on which it stands. For the same reason, it has a worship hall (拝殿, haiden), but no place for the deity to be housed (神殿, shinden).
